MUSIC TRIVIA PILOT EPISODE

Q1 - ERA
Which decade is commonly considered the birth of rock and roll?

CHOICES
1950s - Pick this if you believe rock and roll first hit mainstream identity in this decade.
1940s - Pick this if you think the origin is earlier than most popular histories.
1960s - Pick this if you think rock and roll was born alongside the British Invasion era.
1970s - Pick this if you think the genre did not fully form until later stadium rock years.

S02.text:
CORRECT.

Rock and roll emerged in the 1950s, blending blues, country, and rhythm and blues into a new mainstream sound.

Q2 - GENRE
Which genre is most closely associated with artists like Miles Davis and John Coltrane?

CHOICES
JAZZ - Pick this if you associate both artists with the same core genre.
BLUES - Pick this if you think their work is primarily rooted in blues tradition.
FUNK - Pick this if you think groove-driven funk defines their best-known era.
ROCK - Pick this if you think their influence is mainly within rock music history.

S05.text:
CORRECT.

Miles Davis and John Coltrane are foundational figures in jazz, particularly modal and hard bop styles.

Q3 - ARTIST BIO
Which band originally featured Freddie Mercury as its lead singer?

CHOICES
QUEEN - Pick this if you know Mercury as the original frontman of this band.
ROLLING STONES - Pick this if you think Mercury led a major British rock peer band.
LED ZEPPELIN - Pick this if you think Mercury fronted a different classic rock giant.
PINK FLOYD - Pick this if you think Mercury was tied to progressive rock history.

S08.text:
CORRECT.

Freddie Mercury was the iconic lead singer of Queen, joining the band in the early 1970s.
